Brabus Abu Dhabi (also known as Brabus Island) is developed by Reportage Properties in collaboration with its high-end brand Cosmo Developments . It marks the BRABUS automotive brand's first venture into luxury real estate , bringing the same cutting-edge design and uncompromising quality to an exclusive residential community. Set on its own island in Al Raha Beach's Al Seef district, the project features four high-rise towers with 350 ultra-luxury apartments and an additional 100 villas (including twin villas, townhouses, and beach villas). The concept fuses Brabus's signature automotive-inspired style with contemporary architecture, creating a distinctive "Home of the WOW" lifestyle unique to Abu Dhabi. Every aspect of the design is bold and modern from sleek façades with striking curves to meticulously crafted interiors echoing the unmistakable BRABUS DNA in a residential form . Location is a prime selling point. Brabus Abu Dhabi is strategically located in Al Raha Beach, a prestigious waterfront community in Abu Dhabi. Residents will enjoy direct beach access to pristine sand and sea, as well as scenic canal views around the island. Despite the private island setting, connectivity is excellent - the development lies just 10 minutes from Abu Dhabi International Airport and about 20 minutes from the city center (Corniche area). Major attractions are within easy reach: the famed Yas Island entertainment zone (home to Ferrari World and Etihad Arena) is 15-20 minutes' drive, while the cultural hubs on Saadiyat Island (including the Louvre Abu Dhabi museum) are only 25 minutes away . Even Dubai is accessible in about an hour by car. In short, residents can enjoy serene island luxury minutes away from key landmarks and highways, balancing exclusivity with convenience. Lifestyle & Design: Brabus Abu Dhabi promises a one-of-a-kind living experience combining ultra-luxury and the flair of an iconic supercar brand. Each apartment is crafted to the highest standards, featuring expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that frame stunning panoramic sea views. Interiors boast premium finishes and smart-home technology for modern comfort, including state-of-the-art climate control and branded fixtures. Future owners can choose from three exclusive interior themes - Black & Bold, Gray Haven, or White Bliss each palette inspired by BRABUS's legendary custom cars to reflect a sleek and sophisticated ambiance. All residences come fully furnished with bespoke contemporary pieces and top-quality fittings, right down to custom furniture and stylish lighting, providing a turnkey luxury home from day one. Every detail, from the kitchen layouts to the bathroom fixtures, has been thoughtfully designed to exude elegance and ensure an "instant wow" factor. As an off-plan project, Brabus Abu Dhabi is scheduled for completion by Q1 2029. This timeline gives investors and end-users a comfortable window for payment and planning. The development is freehold for all nationalities, backed by one of the UAE's reputable developers, which adds to its investment appeal. Whether you're a discerning homeowner or a savvy investor, this project represents a rare opportunity - the combination of a branded residence, prime waterfront location, and flexible payment terms means high potential for capital appreciation and rental demand. In essence, Brabus Abu Dhabi delivers not just a home, but a statement in luxury living, set to become a new landmark in Abu Dhabi's real estate landscape. description: Maybach Ultimate Luxury is an iconic Mercedes-branded residential development by Binghatti, located in the prestigious Meydan district. The project features two striking towers, each comprising a basement level, ground floor, mezzanine, five podium levels, and an elegant residential structure - with nineteen floors in Tower A and twenty-five in Tower B. Designed to embody sophistication and architectural excellence, the complex stands as a symbol of branded luxury living in Dubai. The development offers a refined selection of studios and one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to suit both homeowners and investors. Interiors showcase a contemporary aesthetic defined by clean architectural lines, premium materials, rich textures, and a warm, elegant color palette. Every detail is curated to reflect understated luxury and timeless style. Residents are treated to an exceptional array of lifestyle amenities, including a stunning infinity swimming pool, a shared jacuzzi, and dedicated outdoor yoga spaces. The development also features beautifully designed leisure and relaxation areas, premium beauty salons, diverse dining outlets, and well-equipped sports facilities. Complemented by valet parking and professional concierge services, every detail is thoughtfully curated to provide comfort, convenience, and elevated everyday living. The residential component features a refined collection of luxury towers designed to reflect the innovation, performance, and sophistication associated with the Mercedes-Benz brand. Homes are envisioned as contemporary urban sanctuaries, offering elegant layouts, expansive views, and a strong connection to the surrounding cityscape. Premium materials, meticulous detailing, and high-quality finishes define both interiors and common areas, creating a living environment where luxury, precision, and timeless design converge. Location description and benefits Meydan is one of Dubai's most ambitious and prestigious districts, designed as a contemporary urban destination where luxury, nature, and innovation converge. Known for its expansive open spaces and iconic skyline views, the area blends modern residential developments with landscaped parks, waterways, and cultural landmarks. Meydan's master-planned environment offers a sense of scale, openness, and refinement rarely found in central urban locations. The district is internationally recognized for Meydan Racecourse, a world-class equestrian and sporting venue that hosts prestigious global events and anchors the area's elite identity. Surrounding the racecourse are premium residential communities, leisure destinations, retail concepts, and wellness-focused spaces, all thoughtfully integrated to support a high-quality lifestyle. Wide boulevards, pedestrian-friendly planning, and scenic vistas define the everyday experience in Meydan. Strategically located with excellent connectivity to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport, Meydan offers both lifestyle appeal and strong investment potential. Its limited land availability, ongoing development momentum, and growing demand for branded and luxury residences position Meydan as a prime destination for end-users and investors seeking long-term value in one of Dubai's most forward-looking districts.

description: Binghatti Spectre is a mixed-use development by Binghatti, presented under the concept "A Presence Beyond the Visible." The project comprises two towers of contrasting heights rising above a shared podium base, with a sculptural, fluid silhouette. Residence formats include studios, apartments, and Royal Suites in one-, two-, and three-bedroom configurations, alongside dedicated office and retail space. The development is positioned as a contemporary residential and commercial destination, complemented by panoramic city views. Residents have access to a dedicated pool for adults and children, together with a yoga and aerobics platform and a paddle and tennis court for active pursuits. A children's play area sits alongside family sitting and social nooks, while wellness facilities and lounge sitting platforms provide space for relaxation. The development also includes an open lawn, a dedicated jogging and sprint lane, and activity tables with a ping-pong table for recreation. Interior layouts range from efficient studios to expansive three-bedroom residences, with the largest configurations featuring a private pool and a terrace open to the sky, plus dedicated laundry space. Rooms are organized around distinct living, dining, and kitchen zones, with master suites in the larger units. The residences feature modern finishing with high-quality materials throughout, and are delivered unfurnished. Location description and benefits Al Jaddaf is a vibrant and rapidly developing neighborhood located on the banks of Dubai Creek. Known for its strategic location, Al Jaddaf is situated between Dubai's old town and the bustling modern hubs of Downtown Dubai and Business Bay. This unique positioning makes it a desirable area for both residents and businesses, offering seamless connectivity to key parts of the city via major highways like Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, as well as easy access to public transport, including the Dubai Metro and Creek ferry services. Its proximity to Dubai International Airport further enhances its appeal as a convenient and well-connected neighborhood. The area is a blend of tradition and modernity, reflecting Dubai's rich cultural heritage while embracing contemporary urban development. Al Jaddaf is home to the iconic Dubai Frame, a major landmark that offers breathtaking views of the city, and the historical Dubai Creek, which retains its charm as a hub of the city's maritime and trade history. The area also features the Jameel Arts Centre, a cultural hotspot showcasing contemporary art and fostering creative expression, making Al Jaddaf an attractive destination for art and culture enthusiasts. Al Jaddaf offers a well-rounded lifestyle with a growing array of residential, commercial, and leisure options. It features a variety of modern apartment complexes, many of which boast waterfront views and state-of-the-art amenities. The neighborhood's emphasis on green spaces, including the landscaped walkways along the creek, promotes outdoor activities and a healthy lifestyle. With upcoming developments and a focus on enhancing community living, Al Jaddaf continues to grow as one of Dubai's most promising and sought-after residential and cultural hubs.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Lunara Tower by Tarrad Development emerges as an exceptional residential address, a beautifully proportioned building of seven residential floors rising above a ground level and two basement levels, offering a curated collection of one and two-bedroom homes. Comprising one hundred and nineteen residences, this thoughtfully designed development achieves remarkable efficiency, with sellable area representing a remarkable proportion of the allowable gross floor area. Every residence has been carefully planned to maximise space, light, and comfort, creating a refined sanctuary where contemporary design meets everyday practicality. The amenities at Lunara Tower are thoughtfully gathered on a complete rooftop level, creating a vibrant social hub for residents to enjoy. The rooftop features a stunning swimming pool and a dedicated kids' pool, alongside a fully equipped gymnasium, a serene spa, and a beautifully appointed co-working space for those who work from home. Residents also enjoy a games room, a kids' play area, a multipurpose hall, a barbecue area, a padel court, and an amenities reception, ensuring that relaxation, wellness, productivity, and connection are all effortlessly catered for within the building. The residences at Lunara Tower are beautifully furnished, with every detail carefully considered to create an atmosphere of warmth and refined living. The interiors showcase a harmonious palette of ivory stone tones, champagne metal accents, and colourless glass, while continuous balcony bands, slender dark glazing frames, and sculptural supports establish a recognisable residential identity. Each home is delivered fully furnished with premium finishes, ensuring that residents can immediately immerse themselves in the comfort and elegance of their new home, while the chamfered corners and clear glazing articulate the building's presence on its three street frontages with quiet distinction. Location description and benefits Wadi Al Safa 3 offers a well-connected and increasingly desirable setting, positioned along three road frontages that provide excellent accessibility to the wider city. This thriving neighbourhood is served by the Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road as its principal regional connection, alongside Dubai-Al Ain Road and Umm Suqeim Street, ensuring that every journey is effortless and every destination within comfortable reach. The area's strategic position places it at the heart of a rapidly evolving district, where convenience and opportunity converge. The neighbourhood enjoys outstanding connectivity to the city's most popular destinations, with IMG Worlds of Adventure and Global Village just moments away, alongside Dubai Hills Mall, Dubai International Academic City, and Mall of the Emirates all within an easy journey. Residents benefit from proximity to the iconic Dubai Mall and Downtown district, Dubai Marina Mall, and Dubai International Airport, making both business and leisure effortlessly accessible. For global travel, Al Maktoum International Airport is also within comfortable reach, ensuring that the world is always close at hand. The surroundings offer a wealth of retail, dining, and entertainment experiences that enrich daily life, from world-class shopping destinations to vibrant cultural and leisure attractions. The area's continued growth and investment in infrastructure signal a bright future, making it an increasingly attractive choice for homeowners and investors seeking both comfort and long-term value. This distinguished location truly offers the best of both worlds, combining the tranquillity of a well-planned community with the dynamic energy of one of the world's most exciting cities.

A Distinctive Investment & Lifestyle Opportunity Maybach Ultimate Luxury by Binghatti combines prestigious branding, contemporary architecture, premium amenities, and a sought-after Meydan address. title: 78Q2+2Q, Dubai
description: The Arabian Gulf does not offer this view to everyone. At Samana Ocean Crest, it comes with your morning coffee. Fifty-six residences. One island. No compromise. Developed by Samana Developers - ranked fifth among Dubai's highest off-plan sellers by volume in the first half of 2025, with a portfolio valued at over AED 17 billion - Ocean Crest represents the developer's most considered coastal statement to date. Positioned on Dubai Islands, the Nakheel-masterplanned destination that redefines what island living means in this city, the project rises across eight residential floors with a discipline of scale that most developers would not allow themselves: just 56 residences, each one crafted with the attention that only boutique numbers permit. Many homes feature private terrace pools, interiors finished in warm natural stone, wood, and glass, and layouts calibrated around panoramic sea and skyline perspectives. Samana has built its reputation on delivering resort-style living as a lived experience rather than a marketing promise - and Ocean Crest is where that philosophy meets the Gulf itself. THE EXPERIENCE: Life at Ocean Crest operates at the cadence of the sea. Mornings open to the Arabian Gulf with no obstruction, afternoons unfold across a resort-grade amenity landscape, and evenings carry the particular stillness that only island addresses can offer. This is not urban living softened by a view. It is coastal living, fully committed. Private terrace pools - select residences with direct pool access from your own outdoor space Infinity pool and sun deck - a skyline-facing water environment designed for unhurried days Yoga studios and wellness spaces - dedicated areas for restoration alongside the water's edge Spa, sauna, and steam rooms - a full wellness facility integrated into the building's daily rhythm Children's splash pad and family zones - thoughtfully separated spaces for every generation Landscaped gardens and jogging tracks - green corridors woven into the island environment 24/7 concierge and artistic lobby - a resident arrival experience that sets the register from the first step THE INVESTMENT CASE: Dubai Islands is one of the few remaining large-scale waterfront destinations in Dubai where early capital allocation still carries meaningful upside - a Nakheel-developed master community with confirmed infrastructure, beach access, and a pipeline of hospitality and retail that will anchor long-term demand. Ocean Crest's boutique scale of 56 residences operates as a natural scarcity lever in a market where oversupply is the persistent structural risk. Samana's 86% foreign investor demand ratio confirms the international conviction behind the developer's product - and a freehold title on a beachfront island address, at a confirmed entry point of AED 2.2M, positions this well within reach of the buyer profile that this location will continue to attract. With handover in Q3 2028 and a 20/70/10 payment plan, the capital deployment is structured to carry investors through the community's most active development phase. WHO THIS IS FOR: This is for those who have spent enough time in landlocked buildings and have decided, with some finality, that the water is non-negotiable. People who want their Dubai address to signal something more specific than premium - something coastal, considered, and genuinely rare at this scale. Buyers who understand the arithmetic of boutique beachfront freehold on an emerging island master plan, and who also simply want to swim in their own pool on a Tuesday morning with nothing but the Gulf in front of them. Ocean Crest. Fifty-six chances to own the edge of the island.

title: Emaar Ocean Star
description:
Ocean Star is a residential development by Emaar Properties, located within Rashid Yachts & Marina at Mina Rashid, Dubai. The project comprises two residential buildings offering a selection of one, two and three-bedroom apartments, combining contemporary interiors with a waterfront setting and access to the wider marina community.
The development includes 154 residential apartments, comprising 58 one-bedroom, 76 two-bedroom and 20 three-bedroom homes. The apartments feature practical layouts, spacious living areas and private balconies or terraces, with a range of configurations to suit different household needs. The supplied floor plans cover 38 layout variations, with total apartment areas ranging from approximately 789.9 to 2,025 sq ft.
One-bedroom apartments offer efficient layouts with private outdoor space, while two-bedroom residences provide additional room for families and shared living. Three-bedroom apartments feature larger interiors and, in selected layouts, substantially larger balconies or terraces. The combination of indoor living space and private outdoor areas contributes to the development's residential appeal.
Ocean Star is designed around a waterfront lifestyle, with a signature canal pool, landscaped green spaces and recreational facilities. Residents can enjoy access to a gym, recreational courts, a community park and a boardwalk promenade. The surrounding community also provides access to marina facilities, retail and dining options, and nearby educational and healthcare facilities.
Located within Rashid Yachts & Marina, Ocean Star offers access to the waterfront promenade and the wider marina environment. Dubai International Airport is approximately 15 minutes away by car, while Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are around 20 minutes away. With its range of apartment sizes, waterfront setting and community facilities, Ocean Star offers an appealing option for end-users, families and investors seeking a home in Dubai's marina district.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

With easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road, DIFC, and major business hubs, the location is ideal for both lifestyle and professional convenience. Thanks to its central position, reaching Dubai's key attraction points is quick and effortless. From the , Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall are approximately 9 minutes away, Dubai International Airport (DXB) can be reached in around 15 minutes, and the Business Bay Metro Station is only a short distance away. Popular destinations such as Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina are also easily accessible by car, making the area highly suitable for a dynamic city lifestyle. Tekce offers a hospitality inspired living experience with a strong focus on comfort, wellness, and community. Residents can enjoy an impressive range of social amenities, including an infinity swimming pool, temperature controlled pools, state of the art fitness facilities, spa and wellness areas, yoga and relaxation decks, landscaped leisure spaces, BBQ areas, as well as children's pools and play zones. Purchasing a home in or near Downtown Dubai means owning property in one of the city's most iconic and consistently high demand locations, known for its global appeal, limited supply, and strong long-term value. Buying property in Dubai represents more than just homeownership it is an entry into a world of luxury living combined with solid investment potential. Centrally located residences with premium amenities continue to attract both end users and tenants throughout the year. description: Sei Saadiyat: 1-bedroom apartment offering approximately 78 sq m of space within a new residential development by Aldar in Saadiyat Cultural District, Abu Dhabi. The residence features a light interior palette with stone, wood, metal and woven textures, combined with clean forms and carefully balanced proportions. The development comprises six towers and 778 residences. The architectural concept was created by Jacobs, while the interiors were designed by Kettle Collective. The project combines stepped building volumes, landscaped courtyards, elevated gardens and a façade treatment shaped by light and shadow. Sei Saadiyat is located in the heart of Saadiyat Cultural District, approximately 3 minutes from Abrahamic Family House, 4 minutes from Zayed National Museum, and around 5 minutes from Louvre Abu Dhabi, Manarat Al Saadiyat, Berklee Abu Dhabi and Saadiyat Grove. Guggenheim Abu Dhabi, Natural History Museum Abu Dhabi and teamLab Phenomena are about 7 minutes away, while Yas Island is around 20 minutes and Zayed International Airport approximately 25 minutes away. With approximately 78 sq m of space, the 1-bedroom format is well suited to owner-occupiers and buyers considering future rental within Saadiyat Cultural District. Its proximity to the island's major cultural landmarks is one of the project's defining advantages. Handover is scheduled for Q4 2030 . The payment plan is structured as 50/50 , with 5% payable on booking, 45% during construction and the remaining 50% on handover. A key advantage of Sei Saadiyat is the combination of an Aldar development, a prime cultural district location and a distinctive architectural concept. Surrounded by tranquil creek views, striking skylines, and lush green landscapes, this exceptional residential destination offers a harmonious blend of serenity, contemporary design, and urban sophistication. Spanning approximately eight square kilometres, this master-planned community combines contemporary residences, landscaped open spaces, retail destinations, and leisure facilities along the historic Dubai Creek. One of the area's distinctive attractions is Creek Beach, an urban beach designed to bring a relaxed coastal atmosphere to the heart of the community. With approximately 700 metres of white sand, an infinity pool, and beautiful sunset views, it offers an inviting setting for families and residents to enjoy outdoor recreation and waterfront relaxation. The wider destination is also associated with the ambitious Dubai Creek Tower project, designed by renowned architect Santiago Calatrava as a landmark of architectural innovation. Together with the area's contemporary skyline, waterfront promenades, and carefully planned public spaces, these features contribute to its distinctive identity. Dubai Creek Harbour offers a lifestyle that combines scenic surroundings with convenient access to retail, dining, and leisure experiences. description: Samana Greenfield 2 is a refined residential development that brings together contemporary architecture, resort-inspired amenities, and a sense of calm designed for modern urban living. Building on the vision of its predecessor, the development offers thoughtfully designed 1 and 2-bedroom residences created to accommodate different lifestyles while maintaining a strong focus on comfort, flexibility, and long-term appeal. Every aspect of the project is carefully considered to create homes that feel peaceful, functional, and naturally connected to everyday life. The interiors are defined by warm finishes, natural light, and contemporary elegance, creating inviting spaces that balance sophistication with timeless comfort. Thoughtfully planned layouts and carefully selected materials give each residence a welcoming character, while refined detailing ensures a consistent standard of quality throughout. The overall design philosophy focuses on creating a sense of ease, allowing residents to step away from the pace of the city and enjoy a more relaxed atmosphere at home. Samana Greenfield 2 offers an extensive collection of resort-style amenities designed around relaxation, recreation, wellness, and social connection. Residents can enjoy an adult swimming pool, jacuzzi, children's pool, pool deck, barbecue area, sunken seating, and an outdoor cinema. Fitness facilities include both indoor and outdoor gyms, while a dedicated children's play area provides a safe and engaging environment for younger residents. Together, these amenities create a lifestyle where leisure and wellness are seamlessly integrated into everyday living. Location Description & Benefits Located in Dubai International City, Samana Greenfield 2 benefits from a neighbourhood designed around community living, open spaces, and convenient urban connectivity. The area offers a more relaxed residential atmosphere while remaining connected to Dubai's major destinations and commercial hubs, making it an attractive option for residents seeking a balance between accessibility and tranquility. The second bedroom measures 3.3 by 4.2 metres and is served by another full bathroom. Together with the pool and the sweep of the architecture, that dual aspect gives the apartment a sense of privacy and occasion normally associated with a resort home. Aqua Arc's design is shaped by flowing façades, wave-inspired balconies and a restrained coastal palette. The interior concepts combine pale stone, warm timber and soft neutral tones, allowing the water and natural light to remain central to the experience. Known for its iconic skyline, Business Bay offers a mix of world-class residential towers, state-of-the-art office spaces, and high-end retail outlets. Strategically located along the Dubai Canal, it provides breathtaking waterfront views and easy access to major landmarks, including the Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai. With an array of fine dining restaurants, stylish cafes, and leisure destinations, Business Bay is a dynamic urban destination perfect for professionals, families, and investors seeking a modern and upscale lifestyle in the heart of Dubai. are strategically located with access to Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Khail Road, Al-A'amal Street, and Al Asayel Street just 5 minutes from Marasi Promenade, 9 minutes from Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, 10 minutes from The Dubai Fountain, 11 minutes from Dubai Opera, 11 minutes from Museum of The Future, 14 minutes from Coca-Cola arena, 16 minutes from Dubai International Airport, 24 minutes from Jumeirah Beach Residence and Dubai Marina, 35 minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport. The project boasts a striking 102-floor tower with an iconic exterior crafted from high-quality materials, including premium marble, brushed gold detailing, and luxurious finishes such as white and gold marble and carbon fiber accents. Its design combines elegance and functionality with breathtaking aesthetics. Residents can enjoy over 40 premium amenities, including a private pool in every apartment, an infinity pool with canal views, a skyline spa, and a rooftop garden. It also features a wellness club, aquatic gym, indoor and outdoor party spaces, a sky meditation deck, and multiple lounges. Recreational facilities include a bowling center, mini-golf, cross-fit zones, a Zumba deck, a piano walk, and a musical deck. Sports enthusiasts can access cricket, badminton, basketball, and tennis training courts. Family-friendly features include kids' play areas, a trampoline zone, daycare, and a kids' oasis pool. Additional conveniences like a business center, library, beauty salon, health bar, and doctor-on-call services ensure a luxurious and well-rounded lifestyle. The project offers studios, one, two, three, four, and five-bedroom residences, featuring interiors that redefine luxury and elegance. Each unit is fully furnished with Exquisite Dolce Vita-branded furniture, crafted from premium Italian materials and showcasing meticulous attention to detail. The interiors include fitted wardrobes, stylishly designed to maximize space, and kitchens equipped with high-quality white goods, blending practicality with sophistication. The living spaces are adorned with luxurious finishes, including marble flooring, fine wood accents, and high-thread-count linen curtains, while the bathrooms are enhanced with premium Italian fittings. Additionally, each residence is equipped with advanced smart home technology, providing seamless control of lighting, climate, and security to enhance convenience and modern living. Every element, from the convertible kitchens to the opulent grooved doors with golden details, embodies an exceptional standard of craftsmanship, creating an environment of unmatched comfort and refined beauty. description: Beachfront Apartments with Installments on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island in Umm Al-Quwain is a stunning haven that blends luxurious living with breathtaking natural surroundings. This exclusive community offers a range of upscale residences, including waterfront villas and elegant apartments, thoughtfully crafted for a sophisticated island lifestyle. Residents benefit from direct beach access, expansive green spaces, and world-class amenities such as an 18-hole golf course, eco-park, and water sports adventures. With its rich ecological diversity and cultural heritage, Siniyah Island provides a peaceful escape just 50 minutes from Dubai, perfectly balancing tranquility and urban convenience. Umm Al Quwain are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious lifestyle harmoniously integrated with natural beauty, featuring state-of-the-art residential units within multi-use towers ranging from 2 to 10 stories. The development is surrounded by pristine white sand beaches, lush mangroves, and a rich tapestry of unique wildlife. Community amenities include a recreational fishing deck, family-oriented golf course, event cabanas, al fresco dining, and luxury beach cabanas. A seawater lagoon is central to the community, providing facilities for non-motorized water sports such as snorkeling, paddleboarding, kayaking, and floating cinema experiences. Linear parks are equipped with yoga decks, wellness parks, and sports facilities like tennis and paddle courts, alongside skateboarding zones. Additional highlights include a yacht club, mosque, retail mall, public beach, and helicopter landing pad. Residents can enjoy a clubhouse with a gym, library lounge, steam and sauna rooms, and multipurpose spaces. The development also prioritizes sustainability with double-glazed façades, energy-efficient systems, and provisions for electric vehicle charging. The project features meticulously designed interiors that combine elegance with functionality, offering 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments with spacious layouts and high-quality finishes. Each unit is equipped with fitted wardrobes and kitchens that include premium white goods such as an oven, gas hob and hood, refrigerator, and washing machine. The living and bedroom areas are adorned with porcelain tile flooring and finished with matte emulsion paint walls for a sleek yet cozy ambiance. The master bedrooms boast en-suite bathrooms, while all bathrooms and powder rooms are outfitted with premium-brand water closets, washbasins, and chrome-plated fittings. Kitchens feature high-quality reconstituted stone countertops and laminate or high-gloss PET-finished cabinets. description: VERDAN1A 4 is a contemporary residential development located in Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC), designed to bring together modern architecture, nature-inspired surroundings, and sustainable urban living. Offering a diverse selection of studios, 1, 2, 2.5, and 3.5-bedroom apartments, the development caters to a wide range of lifestyle requirements, from individuals and young professionals to growing families. Its architectural concept emphasizes a harmonious relationship between modern structures and landscaped green spaces, creating a residential environment focused on comfort, wellness, and everyday convenience. The development offers a thoughtfully designed collection of lifestyle amenities that encourage relaxation, recreation, and community engagement. Residents can enjoy a swimming pool with a sun deck, a dedicated children's pool, a fully equipped gymnasium, and a welcoming clubhouse. Additional facilities include a children's playroom, outdoor BBQ areas, and a landscaped terrace garden, providing spaces for social gatherings, family activities, and peaceful moments. The combination of indoor and outdoor amenities creates a well-rounded residential experience for residents of all ages. The interiors reflect a contemporary design philosophy, featuring elegant finishes, carefully selected materials, and functional layouts that maximize comfort and usability. Each residence includes an equipped kitchen with modern appliances, offering convenience for everyday living. Apartments are delivered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to personalize their interiors according to their individual preferences while benefiting from thoughtfully planned spaces and refined contemporary detailing. Location Description & Benefits Located within Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC), VERDAN1A 4 enjoys a position in one of Dubai's evolving residential communities, known for its growing selection of modern developments, family-friendly surroundings, and convenient access to essential lifestyle facilities. The area offers a balance between residential comfort and urban connectivity, making it an attractive destination for both homeowners and investors. DLRC benefits from connectivity to major road networks, including Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Dubai-Al Ain Road, providing convenient access to key destinations across the city. Residents can reach established areas such as Academic City, Dubai Silicon Oasis, and Motor City, while Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport are accessible through the wider road network. The surrounding area offers a growing range of retail outlets, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, educational institutions, and healthcare facilities, ensuring that everyday requirements are conveniently accessible. Its proximity to major family entertainment destinations, including Dubai Parks and Resorts, further enhances the area's recreational appeal, offering attractions such as LEGOLAND, MOTIONGATE Dubai, and LEGOLAND Water Park. The wider Dubailand district also provides access to various outdoor and sporting facilities, including parks, cycling routes, fitness destinations, and recreational spaces that support an active lifestyle. As the surrounding residential and commercial infrastructure continues to develop, DLRC is gaining attention as an emerging residential destination within Dubai. With its diverse apartment configurations, nature-inspired design, family-oriented amenities, and convenient connectivity, VERDAN1A 4 presents an appealing residential opportunity for end-users seeking comfortable modern living and investors exploring Dubai's growing residential communities.

description: Project general facts This is a boutique residential building, with a ground floor and four residential floors. Inspired by the idea of composition, the architecture combines warm bronze tones, rounded corners and wide glazed balconies with slim railings, giving the facade a soft, horizontal rhythm. Slatted canopies crown the rooftop, and palm trees and planters soften the edges of the building and its terraces. The compact scale of the project creates a quiet, private atmosphere for residents. Amenities are designed for wellness, leisure and family life. The rooftop features an open swimming pool with sun loungers under a curved slatted canopy, alongside a rooftop lounge with sofas and low tables among landscaped planters. Residents also have a gym with views over the district, an outdoor yoga deck and a barbecue area for gatherings in the open air. Families benefit from a kids' pool and a dedicated kids' play area, while an elegant entrance lobby welcomes residents and guests. The building offers studios and two-bedroom apartments, which suits both single residents and small families. All residences are delivered fully furnished, with refined interiors in soft neutral tones, natural materials and warm lighting. Kitchens and living areas are arranged around natural light, and private balconies extend the living spaces outdoors, while the low-rise, boutique format keeps the building calm and private. Location description and benefits Dubai South Residential District is a master-planned residential area in the south of Dubai, developed around Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai. The district combines low-rise residential buildings, green streets, parks and community facilities in a calm suburban setting, and it continues to grow as new homes, schools and retail are added around the airport and the Expo City business area. Road links connect the area with Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, giving access to Jebel Ali, Dubai Investments Park and the rest of the city. Al Maktoum International Airport, Expo City Dubai, Palm Jebel Ali and Dubai Parks and Resorts are among the major destinations within easy reach, and the wider Dubai South area also includes logistics and business zones that bring jobs close to home for many residents. The district appeals to buyers looking for an accessible entry point into a growing part of Dubai. Compact studios and two-bedroom apartments here suit young professionals, couples and small families who want a quiet residential setting, as well as investors interested in rental demand linked to the airport, the logistics hub and the continued development of Expo City Dubai. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. description: Fully Furnished Apartments with Post Handover Payment Plan in Jumeirah Village Triangle Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT) is a vibrant and family-friendly community in Dubai, offering a perfect blend of urban living and tranquil surroundings. The community features parks, schools, retail outlets, and dining options, ensuring a comfortable and convenient lifestyle. The project offers fully furnished studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments. The interiors are thoughtfully crafted with fitted wardrobes and modern kitchen white goods, ensuring convenience and functionality for residents. The living areas are designed for relaxation and entertainment, with contemporary furnishings and sleek finishes, while the bedrooms provide a serene retreat with soft tones and high-quality materials. description: Palace Residences Hillside Towers A & B sets a new standard for sophisticated living, combining timeless Arabesque-inspired elegance with the tranquillity of nature. Surrounded by lush landscapes and thoughtfully integrated into the prestigious Dubai Hills Estate community, the development offers a peaceful residential setting with convenient access to Dubai's key destinations. Its contemporary architecture features graceful curves, clean lines, and warm, earthy tones inspired by the natural beauty of the surrounding hills, creating an atmosphere of understated luxury and refined sophistication. The development presents an exclusive collection of branded one- to three-bedroom apartments and townhouses, thoughtfully designed to deliver privacy, comfort, and contemporary elegance. Dubai Hills Mall serves as a major lifestyle and entertainment destination within the community, featuring a diverse selection of retail outlets, restaurants, cafés, and leisure attractions. Residents also benefit from access to essential services, educational facilities, healthcare providers, and convenient road connections to key areas across Dubai. description:
Chic Tower is a DAMAC development in Business Bay, set on the Dubai Canal. The tower rises from a ground floor and five podium levels through 36 residential floors to a stepped roof, with undulating terraces that take their shape from the canal's waves. The building holds around 450 homes: studios from 411 sq ft, one-bedroom apartments from 610 sq ft, two-bedroom apartments from 1,145 sq ft and a handful of three- and four-bedroom residences starting at 4,998 sq ft.

Homes are delivered unfurnished with fully equipped kitchens. The three- and four-bedroom units each have a planted terrace with an infinity pool, a personal gym and a projection screen. Wellness shapes the shared spaces: the lobby has workout benches and weights, and the podium holds seven baths, including hot, cold, salt and mud baths, a spa, a beauty bar and an outdoor calisthenics gym. Pools, cabanas, a juice bar, playgrounds, football pitches, party areas and a 180-metre lazy river complete it. Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall and DIFC are close by, and Dubai International Airport is about a 15-minute drive.

Business Bay and Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall metro stations are both nearby. The tower includes just three three-bedroom homes and one four-bedroom home. DAMAC, active in the region since 2002, reported around 42,000 homes delivered as of December 2021. The payment plan is 20% on booking, 20% during construction and 60% on handover, which is expected in Q4 2026. The project is registered with the Dubai Land Department, with its escrow account held at Mashreq Bank.

description: Jaddaf Beach Oasis by Azizi is a contemporary residential development that combines the energy of urban living with the tranquillity of a resort-inspired environment. Offering a selection of modern freehold studios, spacious one-bedroom apartments, and luxurious penthouses, the development caters to residents seeking comfort, style, and an elevated lifestyle. Its contemporary architectural design embraces a relaxed, waterfront-inspired concept, creating a distinctive residential setting where modern sophistication meets everyday convenience. The development features a thoughtfully curated collection of lifestyle amenities designed to bring a resort-like experience into everyday living. At its centre is a striking beach-inspired lagoon, offering residents a refreshing escape from the pace of city life. Outdoor leisure spaces, landscaped areas, retail outlets, and communal gathering zones create opportunities for relaxation, recreation, and social interaction. These facilities are designed to encourage a balanced lifestyle, allowing residents to enjoy moments of tranquillity while remaining connected to a vibrant community. The residences feature contemporary interiors characterised by bright living spaces, modern layouts, and carefully selected finishes. Quality materials and elegant detailing create a refined yet welcoming atmosphere, while stylish kitchens combine contemporary aesthetics with practical functionality. Every element is designed to make everyday living comfortable and convenient, with thoughtfully planned spaces that reflect modern tastes and a sophisticated residential identity. Location Description and Benefits Situated in Al Jaddaf, Jaddaf Beach Oasis benefits from a strategically positioned district that combines urban connectivity, cultural attractions, and waterfront surroundings. Located along the historic Dubai Creek, Al Jaddaf has evolved into a modern residential and hospitality destination while retaining its connection to Dubai's maritime heritage. Its mix of contemporary developments, cultural venues, and leisure facilities creates an appealing environment for residents seeking a central address with a distinctive character. The district offers access to cultural destinations, art spaces, and Dubai Culture Village, which contributes to the area's creative and architectural identity. Its proximity to Dubai Creek provides scenic waterfront surroundings, while nearby hotels, restaurants, cafés, and recreational spaces add to the convenience of everyday living. Parks and open areas further enhance the neighbourhood, offering opportunities to enjoy outdoor activities away from the city's busiest commercial districts. Positioned within the highly anticipated Al Mamsha Raseel development, Nama 3 represents a sophisticated blend of contemporary architecture, high-end finishing, and an unparalleled lifestyle proposition. For those seeking an investment or a home in one of the UAE's most forward-thinking districts, this property offers a unique entry point into a vibrant, future-proof community. The Concept: Sharjah's Premier Walkable Community Nama 3 is located within Zone 3 of Al Mamsha Raseel, a visionary project designed by the Alef Group. This district is celebrated as the first fully integrated walkable community in Sharjah. The design philosophy centers on a "car-free" environment at the ground level, prioritizing pedestrian safety, air quality, and social interaction. Imagine stepping out of your luxury tower directly onto beautifully landscaped walkways, where high-end retail stores, artisanal cafes, and essential services are all within a few minutes' stroll. This layout creates a harmonious balance between the privacy of residential life and the energy of a bustling commercial hub. A Strategic Masterplan: Al Mamsha Raseel The Al Mamsha Raseel sector is strategically nestled along the E311 (Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road), the primary artery connecting the various Emirates. This zone does not exist in isolation; it is seamlessly abutted by two other distinct districts: Al Mamsha Souks and Al Mamsha Seerah. While the Souks offer a nod to traditional Arabian commerce and vibrant marketplaces, and Seerah focuses on residential tranquility and wellness, Raseel acts as the modern, high-tech core. Together, these three zones form a comprehensive ecosystem where residents can work, live, and play without ever needing to leave the neighborhood. Connectivity and Prime Location One of the most compelling features of this 1-bedroom apartment is its central location. Nama 3 offers residents a "best of both worlds" scenario: the cultural and educational richness of Sharjah paired with the commercial proximity of Dubai. Retail and Leisure: For premium shopping and dining, the 06 Mall is reachable within a 5-minute drive. If you are looking for green spaces, the lush Dubai National Park is just a 10-minute commute. Travel Hubs: Global connectivity is a breeze. Sharjah International Airport is only 10 minutes away, while Dubai International Airport (DXB) can be reached in approximately 15 minutes, making this a perfect residence for frequent travelers and international business professionals. Why Invest in Nama 3? The 1-bedroom units in Nama 3 are designed with the modern minimalist in mind, featuring open-plan layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows that invite natural light, and premium materials throughout. As Sharjah continues to grow as a cultural and economic powerhouse, properties within integrated communities like Al Mamsha Raseel are expected to see significant capital appreciation and high rental yields. Whether you are a first-time buyer looking for a stylish sanctuary or an investor eyeing the lucrative UAE real estate market, this apartment in Nama 3 offers a lifestyle defined by convenience, luxury, and connectivity. title: Union Takaya
description:
Takaya is being developed by Union Properties beside Dubai Autodrome in Motor City, near Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. It combines three towers: Takaya Tower rises 29 floors above ground, basement and podium levels, while Symphony and Harmony each have 19. Townhouses and villas sit around a shared podium, for a total of 744 apartments, 39 townhouses and five villas plus retail units. Apartments run from studios to four bedrooms, with one- to four-bedroom layouts of 831 sq ft to 2,339 sq ft, and the four-bedroom townhouses are set over three levels with a roof terrace.

Homes are handed over semi-furnished, with soft pastel interiors and kitchens fitted with Siemens appliances; many layouts add a maid's room and walk-in wardrobes. The 24 shared amenities include lap, recreational and children's pools, three gyms, two squash courts, a paddle tennis court, a golf simulator, a cinema room, co-working spaces, a children's day care and a sky garden. Parking is provided for 1,203 cars, 100 of them enabled for EV charging. A landscaped retail plaza sits at street level, and Motor City's gardens, cycle paths and the Dubai Outdoor Kartdrome are nearby.

Union Properties, founded in 1987 and publicly listed, is the developer behind Motor City, Dubai Autodrome and Uptown Mirdif, and has delivered more than 10,000 units in Dubai. Takaya adds a broad spread of apartment sizes and a limited number of townhouses and villas to this established community between major highways. The payment plan asks for 5% on booking and 15% during construction, with the remaining 80% due on handover, expected in Q4 2027.

title: Wadi Al Safa 3, Dubai
description: The Wilds Residences is a thoughtfully envisioned residential sanctuary that places nature at the very heart of everyday living. Created by Aldar, the project reimagines modern homes as spaces that restore balance, nurture wellbeing, and foster meaningful connections with the natural world. A curated collection of residences ranges from elegant one-bedroom homes to expansive family duplexes, all designed to blend refined architecture with the calming presence of greenery, water, and open skies. The community is enriched by a remarkable range of nature-led amenities that flow seamlessly through the landscape. Residents enjoy tranquil streams, nature-inspired pools, wellness and spa facilities, fitness zones, yoga decks, creative studios, family lounges, co-working spaces, and immersive outdoor experiences such as birdwatching, stargazing, cycling, and scenic trails. At the heart of the community, landscaped parks, adventure play areas, educational spaces, and social pavilions create a vibrant yet peaceful environment where families and individuals can truly flourish. Interiors are designed to reflect an elegant harmony between refined living and organic inspiration. Homes are bathed in natural light and finished with premium materials, offering a choice of light or dark interior palettes inspired by the natural landscape. Kitchens feature engineered stone countertops, contemporary cabinetry, and porcelain finishes, while bathrooms are appointed with high-quality ceramic sanitaryware and brushed bronze fittings. Flooring, wall treatments, and bespoke joinery combine durability with warmth, creating interiors that feel grounded, calming, and effortlessly sophisticate. Location Description and Benefits Wadi Al Safa 3 is an emerging area in the southern part of Dubai that offers a rare combination of tranquility and connectivity. Surrounded by established communities such as Majan and Al Barari, the area is defined by its openness, greenery, and sense of calm, making it particularly appealing for families and individuals seeking a more balanced lifestyle. Its setting allows residents to experience a quieter, nature-forward environment while remaining connected to the city's core. The area benefits from convenient access to major road networks, enabling smooth movement across Dubai and easy reach of key business, retail, and leisure destinations. This accessibility supports effortless daily routines while preserving a feeling of separation from dense urban congestion. The surrounding infrastructure continues to evolve, reinforcing the area's appeal as a long-term residential destination. With its emphasis on space, nature, and thoughtful urban planning, Wadi Al Safa 3 offers an environment that supports wellbeing and long-term livability. The district's proximity to green communities, combined with its strategic location within Dubai, makes it an attractive choice for those seeking a lifestyle shaped by calm, connection, and future growth.

The building is defined by distinctive flowing lines, rounded corners and cascading balconies with integrated greenery. Its façade pairs light-toned surfaces with panoramic glazing and wood-effect decorative elements, while open terraces with landscaped greenery create a layered architectural appearance and connect the building with its surrounding landscape. Road links extend towards Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina, as well as Mall of the Emirates, Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai, bringing major retail, dining and entertainment destinations within reach. For everyday shopping and leisure, The Outlet Village and the attractions of Dubai Parks and Resorts add further lifestyle options close to the district. Dubai South offers freehold ownership, which opens the district to local and international buyers. Its links to Al Maktoum International Airport, Jebel Ali Free Zone and Expo City Dubai position the area close to key aviation, business and events destinations. Combined with road access to established communities such as Dubai Marina and Downtown Dubai, this positioning gives the district appeal for both end users and investors.
